title: @jgmac1106 @dogtrax #smallpoems in hysteria of historia meteors fall up bent realities in might of flight escape the well no meteorite no broken shell
summary: @jgmac1106 @dogtrax #smallpoems in hysteria of historia meteors fall up bent realities in might of flight escape the well no meteorite no broken shell matter finite stories ensconced in quarries of vacuum bound by nature's response an eternity together flying apart
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@jgmac1106 @dogtrax #smallpoems
in hysteria of historia
meteors fall up
bent realities in
might of flight
escape the well
no meteorite
no broken shell
matter finite
stories ensconced
in quarries
of vacuum
bound by nature's
response
an eternity
together
flying apart
